headline: Russia Pounds Ukraine Grid; Iran Braces for Attack
subheadline: Kyiv metro halted, mayor urges evacuation as Russian strikes cut power and water; Iranian air defenses activate across Yazd province
lede: Russia launched massive missile and drone strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure, causing widespread power outages in Kyiv, water supply disruptions, and the shutdown of all metro lines, with Mayor Klitschko advising residents to evacuate. Ukraine retaliated with deep strikes targeting Moscow's four major airports, paralyzing air travel with over 200 flights delayed and 120 cancelled, while also striking Yandex data centers in Ryazan and Kaluga. In the Middle East, an Iranian journalist warned of a potential imminent attack on Iran with danger potentially passing after tonight, as Iranian air defense systems were activated in Yazd province. Israeli Navy struck two ships in the Strait of Hormuz, setting one ablaze, while the US Embassy in Jordan warned of possible Houthi escalation against Saudi civilian infrastructure.

sections.title: Moscow Airports Paralyzed, Kyiv Faces Evacuation
sections.body: Russian missile and drone strikes hit energy infrastructure across Ukraine, causing widespread power outages in Kyiv, water supply disruptions, and the shutdown of all metro lines, with Mayor Klitschko advising residents to evacuate. Ukrainian drones targeted Moscow and surrounding regions, paralyzing all four major airports with over 200 flights delayed and 120 cancelled, while Russian air defense claimed to have shot down 62 UAVs. Ukrainian forces struck Yandex data centers in Ryazan and Kaluga, disrupting major services including taxis, delivery, and AI, with nine people injured in the Kaluga attack. Russian presidential aircraft were forced to divert from Moscow to St. Petersburg due to the ongoing drone threats, demonstrating the operational impact of Ukrainian drone campaigns.

sections.title: Iran Air Defenses Active, Hormuz Ships Hit
sections.body: An Iranian journalist warned of a potential imminent attack on Iran, with danger potentially passing after tonight, as Iranian air defense systems were activated in Yazd province. Israeli Navy struck two ships in the Strait of Hormuz, with one vessel set on fire. The US Embassy in Jordan warned of possible Houthi escalation against Saudi Arabia, including attacks on civilian infrastructure. Yemeni forces engaged Saudi-aligned troops at Bab al-Mandeb, killing many, while IDF killed three Hamas and PIJ militants in Gaza for ceasefire violations.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous escalation on both fronts signals a coordinated pressure campaign, with Russia targeting Ukrainian utilities ahead of winter while Ukraine demonstrates deep-strike capacity against Russian aviation and digital infrastructure. In the Middle East, the convergence of Iranian air defense activation, Israeli naval strikes in Hormuz, and Houthi threat warnings suggests a multi-axis escalation ladder being tested. The diversion of Russian presidential aircraft and the specific timeline on the Iran threat window indicate both conflicts have entered a phase of heightened operational tempo and strategic signaling.
